unit.title: RPV has high variance and needs more traffic

claim.text: Revenue per visitor captures conversion and AOV together, but revenue is highly skewed: in a typical ecommerce case 97% of visitors spend $0, a few spend a lot, so the coefficient of variation can be around 750% (sd $18 on a mean of $2.40). This needs roughly 6x the traffic of a conversion-rate test for the same relative MDE (about 175,000 vs 28,000 per variant at a 3% baseline).

unit.title: Use Shopify Rollouts for server-side theme A/B testing

claim.text: Shopify's native Rollouts does server-side theme A/B testing: the split happens on Shopify's servers before the page ships, so there is no flicker and no speed penalty. It reports numbers but gives no significance verdict, so the statistical judgment is yours (usestorepilot.com; requires a paid plan tier).
